sample_count_correction: 597 means highly overlapping evaluation windows from six source groups. It is not 597 independent training samples; no training or evaluation-parameter fitting is performed here. Recordings do not establish six different subjects. All are previously inspected development/regression recordings.

systems.fixed_waveform: Author cardiac_signals, fixed Forehead, default homodyne on; not a waveform synthesized from HR.

systems.selection: Prespecified diagnostic control; do not replace the default based on its error.

window_protocol.readout: Both reported outputs must be reproduced by the frozen V22 legacy estimator applied to the actual saved waveform and supplied observation/interpolation masks. Native author HR has a different protocol and is diagnostic only.
window_protocol.offline: The full waveform preprocessing is offline; DP uses future windows. Do not label either pipeline real-time.

references.UBFC: Existing duplicate-merged device HR mean in nominal center +/-5s; original dataset relative time origin and coverage rule. Not ECG.
references.data1: Use the unchanged alignment_protocol.json origin and all seven [-5,-2,-1,0,1,2,5] shifts; primary shift 0, int64 UTC subtraction before float seconds; no per-file zeroing or fitted lag. This remains approximate mtime-derived synchronization.
references.synthetic72: Known 1.2Hz color modulation, engineering check, not physiological validation.

comparisons.own: Cout/Cref, MAE/RMSE/Bias/descriptive LoA, P5 and original-Nref R5 for all systems/readouts.
comparisons.common: All-system strict common windows and every same-readout pair. Pair added/lost windows scored separately; original Nref remains denominator.
comparisons.continuity: Consecutive valid output windows, internal breaks, center span and union of actual raw-frame support, never sum overlapping 10s windows.
comparisons.SNR: Saved base, periodic Hann full window, mean detrend, nfft8192, .7-3.5Hz; known/device reference H1 +/-0.1Hz versus other band power. Own/common/paired deltas; not morphology recovery.
comparisons.candidate_reporting: All fixed candidates and diagnostic control fully reported; no per-case best-candidate selection.

minimum_candidate_schema.time_axis: One row per original video frame; resampling must preserve the original video time axis, missing samples remain NA. HR rows cover all planned original 10s/1s windows, rejected final HR columns are NA.

fairness_requirements: Record author code version/hash, weight identity/hash, weight conversion/runtime and known pretraining dataset/split. Explicitly mark dataset/subject overlap or unknown provenance; do not silently call a potentially overlapping benchmark held-out.
Record input resolution, ROI selection, sampling fps/resampling, channel order, filtering band, context length, startup/adaptation period, segmentation/reset and output masking.
cPACE fixed Forehead is not the previous three-ROI fusion; its native .7-3.0Hz core differs from the common .7-3.5Hz scoring band. Native hr_consensus/hr_per_roi are separate diagnostics.
Uniform 10s readout compares saved waveforms under a shared decoder; it is not the original paper benchmark if native ROI fusion/windowing/HR readout differs.
Training on the retained videos, choosing channels/thresholds from reference, or optimizing the data1 time offset is outside this protocol.
